batting.name: Saurav Chauhan
batting.dismissal: c YBK Jaiswal b YS Chahal

batting.name: YBK Jaiswal
batting.dismissal: c GJ Maxwell b RJW Topley

batting.name: SV Samson
batting.dismissal: c Yash Dayal b Mohammed Siraj

batting.name: Dhruv Jurel
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b RJW Topley

balls.text: Walks down, goes across too and uses his reach to scythe it over cover point. Bottom hand came off as he got it off the low full toss.
Wide low full toss, slapped to long-off
Slot on the off-stump tramline, Kohli takes a step across and tries slapping it. Not off the middle, goes to long-off

Kohli's just as proactive, walks across well outside off and cuts the line. Given Avesh is going for yorkers, length isn't an issue when forward. He'll get it on the full toss like he does there. Whips it through midwicket
The perfect wide yorker. It lands just inside the crease, Kohli takes a small step across and tries to jam it offside. Gets nothing on it
Vintage stuff. Walking down, getting it on the low full toss and pumping through the line. Got a bit of width too
Slow into the pitch, 126ks, Green is beaten on the pull. Too early into the shot
Slower bouncer just outside off, beats the pull

Lofts it over the bowler, long-off stops it to the right. Kohli brings up his eighth IPL hundred, the third hundred in his last seven IPL innings. Raises his bat and the crowd appreciate it. It's had its slow phases, Faf's struggle didn't help but he has persisted and gone deep. Low full toss, pace-on, got it off the bottom of the bat.
Misses the line Kohli leaves it. Length ball from around the wicket, way too wide to make him play. Kohli didn't move in the crease
Into the pitch, top-of-stump height, makes room and pulls it o long-on
Slot at the stumps, angling in at the stumps, clipped to long-on. Green turned for two but not on. Again, could he have gone for an aerial shot with ten balls to go?
Run out missed.Green ran through, Kohli didn't, was more than halfway down and the throw from cover was powered into the grass.
Green tries to drag one across but underedges it. Ooh, it spun and was the toe. Very slow and fullish, landed outside off and spun square
Wide and full, slapped to long-off

Amazing slog sweep. Kohli and Chahal exchange smiles. Fist pump from Kohli too. Taken from fifth stump, he got on one knee and reached far forward. Picked it off a length and deposited it flat over wide long-on. Cutting off the length while playing away from the body makes it special
Full and flat on the pads, 92ks, clipped to wide long-on

Taken on the second attempt by Jaiswal at cover. Chahal though, bowling slow at the death is bravery. Kept it away from the arc though, on a length and Chauhan reached out to try and cut it over the in-field. Got it off the bottom. Jaiswal's fumble was a non-issue as it popped up very close and right in front
Full on leg, clipped to long-on
Finally connects with one. Flat into a length, angling in towards off, Chauhan was deep in the crease, pulled it and had a swivel-hop. Just clears the wide-long-on boundary
Makes room early. Ashwin sees him and darts it wide on a length, 97ks, beats the attempted cut
Wide on a length, makes a bit of room and slaps it to long-off
Full on leg, tries to clip it to midwicket. Goes off the pad
Length on leg, whipped to long-on's right
Tries to chop it, gets it off the underedge behind
Kohli tries to late cut a slower one into the pitch. Bounces a bit more than he expected and goes over
Ones to twos are great but this is what RCB need. This was length outside off, he slapped it through point

2016 WC stuff where Kohli dinks it and gets two. That didn't go till where mid-on would've been but the bowler had to run back since there was no midwicket either. Kohli hared for two. Credit to Saurav too. Was a length ball that was nudged off the back foot
Four in the same direction, this time it's with control. This was a creaseline yorker on fifth, Kohli buckled his knee and sliced it late. Perfect timing and placement.
Wide on a length, Kohli knows half a bat is good enough with short third being in. So he flashes without holding back, thickish edge goes wide of that fielder
Bumper at the head, pulled to deep midwicket
French cut towards long leg. Keeper goes back and stops it. Length ball on fifth, tried to steer it off the back foot

All three stumps are rattled. That's one for the fast-bowlers' posters. Maxwell made room, had feet wide apart again and tried to heave it over midwicket. Hard-length ball did him for pace and direction. Bails fly all over the place. Burger does his signature celebration
Tries to pull the tad back of lengther over middle and misses. Great pace from Burger
Tries to pull it, gets it off the edge, maybe onto helmet and to short third
Maxwell's stance telegraphing his intent - fully open, feet wide apart. He's looking to clobber anything in his arc. Burger goes wide and full, slapped to mid-off
Burger runs in and kicks it towards the stumps, might've been close to a run out but no direct hit. Was a length ball that beat the flick and deflected to the other side. Leg bye stolen

Chahal has his man this time, keeps the line wide and has Faf fetching. Holed out to long-on. Buttler ran across to the left, held his balance and took it low. Faf tried to heave it across. The length was there but he danced down and Chahal went wider. Faf continued trying to break free, perishes in the process. His off-day might be a big issue for the day but might be a bigger worry big-picture wise

Boult drops a sitter! He got underneath it, tried to take it above the head and right shoulder, took it a bit too easy almost. Tickles the fingers and hits ground. Faf danced down, Chahal went wide and full, got it out of reach and Faf had to slash. Got it towards long-off where it was dropped
Plinks a slog sweep to midwicket
Slows it down, beats the slog sweep. Chahal loops it up invitingly and goes very full too. It was outside off and Kohli tried to drag it legside
Long-on and long-off are running towards each other. Buttler and Parag slide, the latter pulls it in but it goes onto his body and parries behind, onto the ropes. Was a full ball that was smeared
Burget almost holds onto a blinder, could he have gone with both hands though? He leapt to the right from point and got hand on it, couldn't hold on.
Flighted outside off, let go
Clips the length ball through midwicket. Stopped in the outfield. Timeout's available and RCB take it right away
Shortish at the stumps, delivered from wide of the crease, flogged into the pitch after making a bit of room. Long-off runs across and stops it
Collapses while adjusting with the lower bounce. Was a length ball that was pulled
Length outside off, slapped to long-off

No midwicket, so Kohli whips the full ball on leg through the infield. Deep midwicket runs to the left, half-stops it while sliding. It means Riyan, running from long-on, overruns and has to go back, leap and pull it in. The ball stuck along the fingers and he was clasping but it didn't touch the cushion at any point
Slapped from outside off to long-off
Faf's trying to hit his way out, finds long-off this time. Almost a yorker, just outside off, clears the front leg and drills it with the bat face closing
Yorker on fifth, jammed to the sweeper
Upper cut over short third. On the jump too, it was a legcutter on fifth, not a lot of room or pace but the wrists took over and the timing was on point. Proper elite stuff

Run wasn't on, Faf went anyway. He survives because Avesh can't get the direct hit. He ran about ten metres to the diagonal left, picked it up, turned and bulleted it in one motion. Had lot of time and Faf had given up too.
Overpitched around off, bullets a drive to long-off. First 100 opening stand for RCB this season
Slaps it to long-off

Tough chance goes down. Parag tried to take on to the right, ball was travelling and his reflexes took over. The right foot hopped and the hands went searching, could only parry it behind in the end. Was a shortish ball on the wider side that was belted
Full outside off, bottom-handed drive takes it to long-off
Forehanded down the ground to bring up fifty. 39 balls, there has been a slowdown but he's gotten a couple away and is looking good. This was flat and into the pitch, he spanked it with no fuss
Faf went square-on and shaped for the fine pull the day before. Tried to help it over but gets it off the bottom to short fine leg
Side-arm slinger stuff. Low release, shortish length and just inside the offside tramline. Faf reaches out and plinks a cut
Length on fourth, flat stuff at 92ks, slapped to cover
Slaps the wide length ball, bounce on the lower side again, through cover. Misfield by Hetmyer
Wide on a length, he's slapped it straight to cover. Unhappy to have found the fielder. Chahal still looping it up
Kohli uses his wrists to break free. Amazing power on the flick, reaching down and smashing it on the up from a length. Line was his friend, it was straight enough for him to help it over midwicket
90ks length ball on the pads, tries to glance it. Hits the pad
Gets no bounce for the cut. It's on a length and around, Kohli tried to go square but had missed it and the upper body collapsed
Wide on a length, it's along the tramline. Let go, wide not given. Kohli puzzled, no review though
Slapped past the stumps at the other end. Long-off moves around and stops it. Is that an incomplete run? Yeah, Kohli's bat slid along the crease but not past it. Short run
Pulls again, over midwicket for the second six of the over. 135ks, shortish and over the stumps, this one was top-of-waist height
Wide of the crease, around the wicket. Angle in is sharp. Fullish and around fourth, stirred to long-off's right
Pulls the shortish slower one into the grass. Goes to square leg
Faf finally launches one. It's over the bigger boundary too, no one at midwicket. This was shortish and at the body, waist-height, he had a small hop on impact
Slaps it off the back foot to cover
Opens the face and guides it to short third. Takes off for a single, Faf not interested. Kohli not pleased but that looked tight. Length ball on off, he opened the face fully and defended late
Keeps lower than Faf expected. He crouches and punches the length ball to long-off. Just short of length and at middle, so he had to play at that
Tries to go for the slog sweep, underedges it to short fine. Is that him trying to make a play? This was full and at the pad, looped up too.
Full around off, pushed to long-off
Chops it into the pitch, lobs up the bowler's left. This was flat and on top of off
A bit short, not sure about the line as the batter made room. Carves it to deep point
Fullish on leg, clipped to long-on
They're milking him. Can they go harder though, as Karthik suggests here. On the pads, clipped around the corner
Length on leg, carrom stuff, stays legside and punches to long-on
Length just down leg, clipped to long leg
Works it down the ground
Kohli does to Ashwin what he did vs Pakistan at the MCG. Bends his leg and pushes towards off to let the ball go down leg
Makes a bit of room early. It's length on middle and leg, 90ks, slapped to long-on
Looked like that legcutter again. 118ks, Shortish and just outside off, pulled to deep midwicket. Timeout
Shortish, pace on. Pulled to mid-on for a quick run. Direct hit from Ashwin but the batter was in
Was that slow or just low bounce? Legcuter on a shortish length, sixth stump, doesn't rise as much as Kohli expected. Still got bat on the pull, not the power though. Finds midwicket
Good stop at mid-off, moves to the right, slides, stops and throws does Buttler. Faf stood legside of the length ball and slapped it
Shortish just outside off, bunted with a flat bat towards mid-off
Short and wide, meat and drink for Kohli. He's just outside the crease and slaps it in front of point
Fullish and at the stumps, clipped to long-on
Slower this time, Ashwin's leaning away at the release too, which in helping angle the ball in. It's on a length and around off, pushed towards cover
Flattish and into the pitch, punched in front
Almost spooned back to the bowler. May have stuck in the pitch a bit. Just back of length, fourth stump, Kohli stood leg side and tried caressing it with a flat bat
Length just down leg, clipped to long-on. Back-foot play
Full on leg, nudged to square leg
Slides legside and pumps it straight. It was too full and on off, Faf's back leg made room and the hands took over.
Full on the pads, clipped to deep square leg. Surprised he didn't try to power it or place it in the gap
Punched to mid-off's right for a quick single
Shortish outside off, guided through the offside. Just behind square
Use-the-pace pull. Short at the body, Kohli swivels and picks it up from waist-height, the easy, controlled caress of the blade from low to high is gorgeous. Sails over square leg

Test-quality off-drive to mid-off. The optics have been fire from Virat so far. This was overpitched and middle, just happened to find the fielder. He trodded halfway down the pitch for the run before realising it went straight to the fielder
Tap and run to the offside. Doesn't look like sideways movement is an issue right now because that was on the up and slightly away from the body
Runs down and tries to guide it through the vacant deep-third area. Got a back-of-length wobbler on fifth, parried it a millisecond too early. Went off the middle but to point
Creams the pull. Swivels and eases it. Has ample time to channel it through midwicket. Boult's short-ball ploy to Kohli isn't troubling the batter. 134ks
Length on the pads, clipped legside. Might've been bat-pad
Sharp bouncer, well directed. Kohli tried to help it along with the pull, gloved it into the grass behind. He's unhappy
Waits and slaps it. Faf stands with an open stance and follows the length ball with his hands. Slaps it from sixth to cover
Whippage, Kohli's on the charge. This was bread and butter despite coming in at 148ks, fuller side of length but on the outer half of the pad. He spanked it through square leg with a flourish
Length on leg, beats the flick and goes legside
Wipe-pull, uses his wrists and turns the bat on the pull. Picks it up from a shortish length and just outside off too, cleared midwicket with ease. Heck of a shot
Shortish but hits top of the pad. Skidded through at pace too. Beats the hopping flick and rolls offside
Overpitched on the pads, beats the flick and hits the pad. A bit of curve in
Pitched up on middle, no swing, pushed to mid-off
Wide even for first slip, almost yorked him too. Jaiswal moved to the right but the ball fizzed past him. Very full, too wide. Burger's on the opposite issue that Boult faced first up
Too short, the ball angling away means there's width for Faf to flash. Carves the wobble ball over cover
Length on fourth again, defended to cover
Better line. Probably would have been the ideal ball first up. Faf stays legside and pushes it towards cover
On middle and leg if not leg, tucked to square leg
Down leg, swings further. Shortish length again, Kohli tried to glance it fine, with a flurry, missed it
Shortish again, at the body, clipped off the back foot to square leg again
Bit too short to start. 133ks and at the body, tucked with ease to square leg

and he ends it with a six!!!! Shortish, into the body, and it wasn't his most sweetly hit pull, but it was sweet enough, landing just outside the boundary to the left of the man at deep square leg. Utter delight for Butter, who David-Warneresque bat-stabbing leap after yanking his helmet off. Hetmyer celebrated just as hard too. Royals have begun the season with four wins in a row.
Well, there's the single. Shortish outside off, bottom-edges the pull into his right heel, and it rolls away into the backward point region
in the blockhole on middle and leg, clipped away to deep square leg
short, angling away wide outside off, left alone. Wide given, and RCB review it... It's tight, but it's just outside the wide guideline. Was pretty high too

they'll definitely need a miracle now. On the shorter side of a length, finishing around middle and off. Clears his front leg and pulls in the air, landing the ball in the gap between deep backward square leg and deep midwicket
full on off stump, driven to mid-off, where Faf stops it but stumbles slightly, turning a tricky single into a relatively straightforward one
now he bowls a really good short ball that keeps coming into Buttler with the angle while he looks to lean back and ramp it fine. Can't connect
makes room and he goes yorker, fifth-stump, and nails it. Reaches out to slash but can't connect
again he looks to make room, and again Green follows, this time with the short ball at the body. Checked pull out to deep square leg
shortish outside off, extra bounce to beat the angled-bat slash
sees Buttler making room and follows him with a ball at his pads. Clipped away neatly into the gap between long-on and deep midwicket for yet another double
back of a length on off stump, worked away to the left of mid-on
fullish, angling into the stumps, clipped watchfully into the on side
fullish, angling into middle and leg and maybe straightening. Shapes to flick, ends up leading-edging into the covers

and that encapsulates RCB's night. For the second time, two fielders converge and leave the ball to each other. Deep midwicket and deep backward square leg. Short ball, gets up to shoulder height outside off, and Hetmyer did well to keep his pull down
slower bouncer outside off, uses his wrists nicely for an almost overhead flick out to deep midwicket
full, angling in towards off stump, plays a checked drive past the stumps, to the left of mid-off
given, and Jurel goes to the old strangle down the leg side. Length ball down the leg side, looks to flick it away, gets a nice, audible inside edge and DK does the rest
length ball on off stump, clipped into the vacant wide mid-on region. Both long-on and deep midwicket hare in and neither can prevent the second run
back of a length close to off stump, dabbed down to deep third

length ball angling in, finishing just outside off, and Buttler plays that open-faced slice again. Doesn't move his feet much at all, just slices at the ball and sends it running away to the right of the diving short third fielder
back of a length close to off stump, dabbed down to deep third

timed perfectly, and straight to the fielder. Back of a length, angling into off stump, flicked imperiously off the hip but straight into Kohli's hands at short midwicket. Catches it in front of his right shoulder with the reverse-cup
length ball angling into the stumps, defended back to the bowler
full outside off, driven to deep cover point

full, angling into middle stump, and Buttler clips it neatly into the gap between long-on and deep midwicket. Maxwell, racing right from long-on, dives and flicks the ball to Kohli coming in the opposite direction

shot! That's only marginally short, and it's angling in and finishing on off and middle or thereabouts, so Parag had to pick the length super early and open up his hips to create swinging room. He does so, and pulls it handsomely over midwicket
in the blockhole on off stump, jams his bat down and keeps it out

got him, Siraj ends the partnership with a well-directed short ball. Angles it in, gets it to bounce to shoulder height, cramps Samson for room. He takes on the hook, and it almost comes off, but Dayal takes the catch at deep backward square leg with his right foot an inch short of the boundary cushion
shortish outside off, pulled along the ground to deep midwicket
very full, angling in towards off stump, driven down to long-on
shortish outside off, steered to deep point
length ball close to off stump, Buttler plays a checked punch to long-off
too much width. A touch short too, leans back and rolls his wrists over beautifully to pierce the gap between backward point and deep cover point
back of a length close to off stump, stabbed to backward point
length ball slanting into a very wide line outside off, left alone
shortish outside off, slapped to deep point
length ball wide of off, reaches out to cut towards backward point, who cuts it off quickly to his right, but can't stop the single despite a slight mix-up
back of a length close to off stump, steered down to deep third

slower ball, back of a length, finishing just outside off. It loses so much pace off the deck that it seems to stop in the air at the top of its bounce, and Buttler somehow flat-bats it and clears a leaping long-off with ease. Amazing power, generated through the hips and by that iron bottom hand
in the blockhole on middle and leg, and Buttler has all the time in the world to get his left foot out of the way and jam an open-faced bat down to stab towards backward point
short, rising ball angling away outside off, this time Buttler brings out the forehand crosscourt to long-on
slower short ball, Buttler picks up two with a tennis-smash pull that rolls slowly towards deep midwicket
sits deep in his crease, punches this off-stump length ball out to the right of deep cover point
length ball slanting across to off stump, uses his wrists to clip it towards long-on
full on off stump, whipped to deep midwicket. I think he was looking to go through the covers and ended up dragging it with his bottom hand taking over
legbreak, on the shorter side, uses his wrists to work it to long-on from outside off stump
back of a length on leg stump, tucked away through square leg off the back foot
shortish, a bit of width, and that's a terrific shot. Great use of the hands to manipulate the bat face on that cut, sends it to the left of the sweeper while constantly curving away from him
quickish legbreak on the pads, clipped gently towards deep midwicket
and he sends down a half-volley that Buttler dispatches ruthlessly. Gets his left foot out of the way and launches it straight back over the bowler's head
Four more, and Royals are heaping the pressure on Dagar. Century partnership comes up now. Drops short, and Samson swivels fiercely into a pull to beat deep backward square leg to his left

lovely. Steps out, steps away to the leg-side again, and manufactures room for a classical inside-out loft that carries all the way over the extra-cover boundary. What a way to bring up his half-century
back of a length close to off stump, punched to extra-cover
shot. Makes a ton of room, exposes all three stumps, and Dagar's stump-to-stump ball ends up giving him all the room he needs to launch over the covers
steps out and Dagar follows him, fires it at his feet. Looks to make room to drive inside-out, ends up dragging it to midwicket off the inside half of the bat

length ball on off stump, punched to the left of short etxra-cover, and not a long way to his left. And that nearly leads to a run-out!  Buttler had hared out, Samson had taken a few steps out but stopped, and the throw should have ideally gone to the bowler's end, but it goes to the keeper instead
length ball close to off stump, eased to deep cover point with a straight bat
shortish, angling into Buttler's hip, pulled to deep square leg, and there's Buttler's first half-century of the season. Just what Royals needed today
full-toss, stump-high, angling into the batter. Hops and works it to deep midwicket
short, wide, and Samson gets both feet off the ground to be able to connect with this uppercut as he wants to, and he connects superbly to send it soaring over the third man boundary
on the fuller side of a length, outside off, punched to deep cover point
fullish, close to off stump, Samson plays a checked drive to long-on
on-pace short ball outside off, may have bounced less than Buttler expected, sneaks under the attempted pull
length ball close to off stump, punched to the left of mid-off
goes short now, and cramps Buttler for room on the pull. Ends up hitting it in the air but it lands short of fine leg coming in off the boundary
another offcutter, but offers width this time, and Buttler frees his arms for a slap-drive to the right of the diving short extra-cover fielder

slower offcutter, shortish. Samson looks to shuffle across and scoop it fine, ends up edging into his own body. Ball richochets into the unmanned short-leg region, and Buttler calls his partner through for a stolen single
length ball on off stump, punched to short extra-cover
tossed up outside off, driven to the left of long-off
back of a length, keeps low on a stump-to-stump line, and Samson plays with a vigilantly straight bat to pick up a punched single to long-on

wrong'un, but it's short, and Samson goes through with the pull despite being a little cramped for room. Doesn't quite middle it, and Kohli, throwing himself forward after running in off the midwicket boundary, can't quite get to the ball in time. Ball ends up yorking him and running away to the boundary
shortish outside off, slapped away to the left of sweeper cover
short outside off, plenty of room for Samson to free his arms and pull fiercely between deep midwicket and long-on. Ends up bisecting the two, helped by the fact that both left the ball to the other
back of a length close to off stump, punched to long-off
good-looking shot for two. Length ball close to off stump, punched firmly with a straight bat, between the stumps and non-striker and to the left of long-on
back of a length, angling down leg, can't connect with the tuck off the hip
back of a length, finishing around off stump, opens up at the hip to pull over midwicket and plop the ball into the gap to the left of deep square leg
length ball angling into off stump, nice turn of the wrists to pick up a single to the right of midwicket
length ball angling into the top of off, punched to the left of mid-off
shortish ball at the hip, Samson whips it in the air, to the right of deep square leg
back of a length, angling into middle stump, clipped watchfully to midwicket
20 off the over. Buttler ends the powerplay with a double, a full ball driven to the left of long-off

a touch short again, and Buttler picks up four more. These errors in length get hidden sometimes when they happen outside the powerplay, but with cover point inside the circle rather than sweeping on the boundary, there's no margin for error

now he overcompensates, dangles up a hit-me half-volley on middle and leg, and Buttler gets his front leg out of the way and drills a lofted drive straight back over the bowler's head. Lovely use of the wrists there
bam. Buttler's really making these marginally short balls pay. Opens up at the hips once more to create swinging room, and hammers a flat-bat pull over wide mid-on
length ball on off stump, defended into the covers
starts with one that's just a touch short, on off stump, and Buttler makes a bit of room and punches it firmly to beat cover to his right and Maxwell haring to his left at long-off
length ball finishing around middle stump, clipped away to deep square leg
shot. A touch shorter, finishing around off stump, and he makes a bit of room and half-slaps, half-punches it into the gap to the left of extra-cover
length ball slanting away into the corridor, opens his bat face and steers to short third
the feet aren't quite moving yet. The ball does, though, nips away from a length, and Buttler, looking to punch through the covers, is beaten on the outside edge
length ball close to off stump, looks to drive with hard hands, slices it into the point region

was that deliberate? Looks like it. Just back of a length, slanting across the stumps, and he rides the bounce and meets it under his eyes, opens his bat face to steer it between short third, who's quite fine, and backward point
good short ball, gets it up towards the back shoulder, and Buttler controls the pull well, hitting it along the ground towards deep square leg
length ball close to off stump, punched crisply with the full face, to the right of mid-off
fuller now, on the stumps, clipped to the right of mid-on
back of a length close to off stump, punched to the right of point

another length ball, close to off stump, a bit of away shape, and Buttler gets away with a mishit. Was looking to go over mid-off, ends up slicing it over cover point instead, and Green, turning around and running towards the ball dropping from over his shoulder, can't quite get to it with the dive

and Buttler puts him away, perhaps not exactly where intended. Starts with a length ball on a fourth-stump line, and he shuffles across to try and scoop over short fine. Ends up top-edging it slightly, over the keeper's right shoulder

back of a length, a bit of inswing to keep the line tight on the stumps. Hops to ride the bounce and work it leg-side, ends up inside-edging into his legs. Ball ricochets into the off side for a single
low full-toss at Samson's feet, clipped to deep square leg

fullish, a hint of swing in towards middle and off, and Samson meets it with the perfect straight drive. Small stride to the ball, gets his head over it, and presents the full face to punch it between the non-striker and the stumps
full, swinging into Buttler's feet, clipped to deep square leg
short, very wide, and Buttler, both feet in the air, reaches out to slash but can't connect. Looks long and hard at the umpire but no wide given
length ball, straightens into Buttler, finishing around middle and leg. Clipped watchfully towards midwicket
bang. Not all that short from Dayal, but just short enough, and the angle means the ball ends up just far enough outside off for Samson to free his arms and pull this authoritatively over midwicket
length ball slanting across to off stump, punched firmly back to the bowler. May have swung away from the right-hander, starting just outside leg and finishing around off
nice shot, straight to the man at short cover. Length ball, finishing around off stump, and he hangs back and punches with a high left elbow
shortish, wide of off stump, may have kept slightly low, Samson tries to cut and the ball sneaks below his bat
length ball slanting away from off stump, and Samson stays leg-side of the ball and uses that bit of room to punch crisply between backward point and cover point
Nice length, nips away slightly after pitching around leg stump. Stays in the crease to defend, gets a thick inside edge into his pads

oooooh, past the inside edge, and that didn't miss the stumps by much! Bounced just over middle stump, in fact. Buttler defending from the crease, no footwork, and the ball swings in late and beats the inside edge
back of a length, straightens towards middle and leg, shows the full face to punch to the right of mid-on
just short of a length again, on the stumps this time, defended into the on side
back of a length, slanting across and straightening slightly to tuck Samson up as he looks to punch into the covers. Thick inside edge past his leg stump
